title: Get a licence to run a market
what: Get the council's licence before setting up or running a market on council property or a public place.

laws.title: Shire of Morawa Public Places and Local Government Property Local Law 2018

sources.title: Shire of Morawa Public Places and Local Government Property Local Law 2018
sources.locator: cl 6.2(1)(o), as made, Gazette No. 173, 13 Nov 2018
sources.quote: A person must not, without a licence—
